Banner.Description: I am a Cloud and DevOps Engineer with experience designing and deploying scalable cloud solutions, automating CI/CD pipelines, and implementing predictive scaling with Kubernetes and Terraform on AWS. I am dedicated to optimizing cloud infrastructures, ensuring security, and improving operational efficiency.
AboutMe.Title: About Me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: In my experience as a DevOps and Cloud Engineer, I have taken on roles such as Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer, and Full-Stack Developer. I thrive in building scalable systems, automating processes, and creating solutions that drive efficiency and innovation.
My capabilities include designing secure cloud architectures, optimizing CI/CD pipelines, implementing predictive scaling, and developing tools that enhance workflows and system reliability.
I also enjoy working on personal projects, exploring emerging technologies, and expanding my skillset for both hobby and utility.
Technologies I have worked with and trained in, along with the awards I have received, include:
Experience.Title: Experience and Education

Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines with AWS CodePipeline and Jenkins, automating deployments.
Leveraged Kubernetes and Terraform to build scalable and automated infrastructure.
Monitored system performance with Prometheus and containerized applications with Docker.
AWS Cloud9, Lambda, API Gateway, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, Docker, Prometheus

AWS EC2, S3, Auto Scaling, IAM, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Jenkins

Azure DevOps, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, Jenkins

AWS EC2, TypeScript, Docker, React.js, Python, Express.js, MongoDB

FeatureProjects.Title: My Projects
FeatureProjects.Label: Highlighted Project

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: DevOps CI/CD Pipeline
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: A robust and scalable CI/CD pipeline built with Jenkins, Terraform, and Docker. Featuring automated deployments, SonarQube for code quality, Trivy for security, and real-time monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana, this project embodies resilience and iterative learning in DevOps.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Bee: SaaS Platform
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Bee is a self-hosted SaaS platform enhancing team collaboration and productivity for entrepreneurs. Built with Kubernetes, Docker, Heat and OpenStack, it features Azure DevOps pipelines, secure API Gateway, and Terraform for automated provisioning, ensuring flexibility, security, and reliability.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Pixie: Multi-Platform Learning App
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Pixie is a multi-platform app (web, desktop, and mobile) designed to help children learn, socialize, and play. Built with Symfony, MySQL, Java, JavaFX, and Flutter, with system design modeled in UML. The project emphasizes a safe, engaging experience for young users while fostering collaboration with tools like Git and GitHub.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Edukupvisio: Cloud E-Learning Platform
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Edukupvisio is a dynamic e-learning platform built using React.js for the front end and Node.js, Express.js for the backend, providing a seamless and intuitive user experience. The platform was deployed using AWS EC2 and Docker for scalability and reliability. Additionally, I used Python BI tools to analyze data and deliver actionable insights that informed feature enhancements and improved the platform’s overall functionality.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Omnia: Charity Multi-Platform
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Omnia is a web and mobile app built to simplify charitable giving. Developed with Flutter and the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js), Omnia allows users to donate money, organize events, donate blood, and auction items with proceeds going to charity. Hosted on Azure, it offers a seamless experience for users to contribute and make a difference.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Win: Discover, Connect, and Socialize
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Win is a mobile app designed to help users navigate new cities with ease. Built with Flutter and powered by Firebase, Win allows users to find the nearest coffee shops and restaurants while also connecting with others nearby who use the app. Whether you're exploring a new place or looking to socialize, Win makes it simple to discover and engage with your surroundings.

OtherProjects.Title: More Projects

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: AI-Powered Auto-Healing and Predictive Scaling in Kubernetes
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Developed an AI traffic prediction model with TensorFlow and Prometheus to optimize resource allocation in Kubernetes clusters. Deployed resilient clusters using Terraform and RBAC to ensure continuous reliability.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: AWS Infrastructure Setup
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Designed a secure and scalable AWS infrastructure using VPC, subnets, and auto-scaling for high-availability applications. Implemented advanced security measures with Security Groups and bastion hosts to ensure controlled access.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: AI-Powered Heatmap Application
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Developed an AI-powered heatmap application using Python and TensorFlow for efficient visualization of complex data insights. Streamlined deployment using Kubernetes and Docker, reducing operational overhead and improving scalability.
